title: STREET: A MULTI-TASK STRUCTURED REASONING AND EXPLANATION BENCHMARK
reasoning: The paper introduces a new benchmark (STREET) for multi-task structured reasoning and explanation. It focuses on evaluating reasoning capabilities in domains such as quantitative reasoning (math), analytical reasoning (logic puzzles), and deductive reasoning (common-sense and science questions). There are no components dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
